name: Voiceflow
summary: Enterprise platform for building, launching and monitoring chat and voice AI agents for customer support.
description: Teams design agents in a visual builder — playbooks, workflows, knowledge base, tools, global prompt and guardrails — then deploy the same agent to web, app, WhatsApp, SMS and voice. Production features include environments, observability with LLM-powered evaluations, live agent handoff and integrations with Zendesk, Salesforce, HubSpot and Shopify; docs ship as markdown and as an MCP server.
contains: visual agent builder: playbooks, workflows, knowledge base, tools
omnichannel: web, app, WhatsApp, SMS and voice (500 ms voice latency claimed)
integrations: Zendesk, Salesforce, HubSpot, Shopify and more
docs as markdown plus a docs MCP server for Cursor and VS Code
compliance pages: SOC-2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA
pricing: usage-based for agencies/partners, request pricing for businesses; free trial
